items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: I had to come back to Charlie Parker and Dexter and Lester and all of those people.

ctx.x: I mean I had to re-learn, I had to learn about chords. I had to learn about bebop. I had to learn about 2-5-1s and all of that stuff because the music I came into was free modal music. So I had to come back to Charlie Parker and Dexter and Lester and all of those people. But I did because I love all of that music. So anyway going to Zappa, no, Zappa wasn’t weird because where I was coming from made Zappa look like Bill Haley. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
